findings: Bookings fallback data integrity — when adminGetAllBookings fails, the page falls back to useMyBookings, showing only the admin's personal bookings while labelled 'Overview of all customer bookings'. Remove the fallback or replace with a hard error state when the admin endpoint is unavailable.

adminGetStats error not caught per spec — the spec required a try/catch that returns a zeros object on failure; the implementation propagates errors to React Query instead. Update the spec contract or add the try/catch.

adminGetTripById undocumented deviation — the edit page calls GET /api/v1/admin/trips/:id, which is not listed in FEAT-001 and deviates from FEAT-002's bulk-fetch strategy. Verify this endpoint exists in trip.controller.ts; a missing route silently surfaces as 'Trip not found'.
